subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: ICreateQueryConfig and ICreateEntryConfig interfaces were not updated with a live_preview parameter. The prescribed fix requires adding an optional live_preview field to these interfaces so that live preview hash data can flow through to Contentstack queries.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: { content_type_uid: string; entry_uid: string }` to both ICreateQueryConfig and ICreateEntryConfig, and also to IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry, and IContentstackGetSingleEntry.

issues.description: createContentTypeQuery and createContentTypeEntryQuery do not call query.includeFallback() or pass live_preview context to the Contentstack query chain. Even though the Stack is initialized with live_preview config, queries will always return published content because the live_preview hash from URL params is never forwarded.
issues.suggestedFix: In createContentTypeQuery and createContentTypeEntryQuery, accept the live_preview param from config and call `query.includeFallback()` (or set the live_preview query param) before returning the query. Also update getEntry, getSingleEntry, and findSingletonEntry to accept and forward the live_preview parameter.

issues.description: The prescribed ContentstackProvider component with useState for reactive content and useEffect subscribing to LivePreview.onEntryChange() was never created. The file does not exist at the expected path. Without a reactive state mechanism, no downstream consumer (236+ components using useContent) can ever receive live preview updates. Every acceptance criterion related to real-time updates is unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Create src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx with a ContentstackProvider that uses useState for content, initializes @contentstack/live-preview-utils LivePreview.init(), subscribes via onEntryChange to re-fetch content with the live_preview hash, and updates context state so all useContent consumers re-render with draft content.

issues.description: The @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency is not installed anywhere in the project. No import of this package exists in the codebase. Without the SDK, no WebSocket-based Live Preview subscription can be established on the client side.
issues.suggestedFix: Add @contentstack/live-preview-utils to package.json dependencies and install it.

issues.description: useContent calls useContext(ContentstackContext) but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return a static value and cannot propagate live preview updates to the 236+ consumers.
issues.suggestedFix: Once the reactive ContentstackProvider is created, ensure useContent consumes the context value that updates on live preview entry changes. The hook itself may not need changes if the Provider supplies reactive state, but verify the context import path matches.

issues.description: No pages/api/preview.ts route exists to enable Next.js draft mode. Without this, getStaticProps will not re-run on CMS edits and the live preview session cannot be established server-side.
issues.suggestedFix: Create src/pages/api/preview.ts that calls res.setPreviewData() to enable Next.js draft mode, and a corresponding exit-preview route to disable it.

issues.description: getStaticProps does not forward context.preview or the live_preview URL param to getSingleEntry/getEntry/findSingletonEntry service calls. Even if the service layer supported live_preview, draft content would never be fetched because the page-level code doesn't pass preview context through.
issues.suggestedFix: In getStaticProps, read context.preview and context.previewData (or the live_preview URL query param), and forward it as the live_preview parameter to all Contentstack service calls (getSingleEntry, getEntry, findSingletonEntry).

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. There are no tests mirroring src/context/ for a ContentstackProvider, no tests for live_preview config in Stack options, no tests for includeFallback() behavior, and no tests verifying reactive content updates. The test count has not increased to cover this new feature, violating the requirement that new features have corresponding vitest unit tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring src/ paths: tests for ContentstackProvider onEntryChange callback behavior, tests for live_preview config in Stack options, tests for includeFallback() being called when live_preview is present, and tests verifying reactive content updates propagate through useContent.

issues.description: The live_preview config block IS present in the options object (management_token, host, enable), which correctly addresses part of the prescribed root-cause fix for server-side draft content fetching. However, this alone is insufficient — without includeFallback() calls on queries and without the client-side reactive mechanism, the live_preview config is inert.
issues.suggestedFix: This is acknowledged as correctly implemented. Complete the remaining prescribed fixes (includeFallback on queries, reactive Provider, preview API route, getStaticProps forwarding) to make this config actually functional.
